title: Stock label
statement:
Give a label that says whether the product can be bought.

Give `"in stock"` when `stock` is more than 0. Give `"sold out"` otherwise.
reference: if .stock > 0 then "in stock" else "sold out" end

title: Kinds of reply
statement:
Turn every status code into a word.

The input is an array of numbers. A code under 400 becomes `"ok"`. A code from 400 to 499 becomes `"client error"`. A code of 500 or more becomes `"server error"`. Give one array of strings, in the same order. Use `elif` for the middle case.
reference: map(if . < 400 then "ok" elif . < 500 then "client error" else "server error" end)

title: Delivery cost
statement:
Give the delivery cost of every order.

The input is an array of orders with an `id` and a `total`. Delivery costs 0 when `total` is 50 or more, and 5 otherwise. Give an array of objects with `id` and `delivery`. Put the `if` in brackets inside the object: `{id, delivery: (if ... end)}`.
